mapper.select: /* SQL_ID: com.hanatour.air.ols.flightPriceSnapshot.ec.qc.FlightPriceSnapshotMapper.findFlightPriceSnapshotCompetitorList */ SELECT T.SNAPSHOT_ID , T.RANK_NO , TO_CHAR(T.FARE, 'FM999999999990.00') AS FARE , T.AGENCY_CODE , T.AGENCY_NAME FROM ( SELECT A.FARE1, A.FARE1_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE1_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE2, A.FARE2_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE2_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE3, A.FARE3_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE3_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE4, A.FARE4_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE4_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE5, A.FARE5_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE5_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE6, A.FARE6_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE6_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE7, A.FARE7_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE7_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE8, A.FARE8_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE8_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE9, A.FARE9_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE9_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE10, A.FARE10_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE10_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE11, A.FARE11_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE11_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE12, A.FARE12_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE12_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE13, A.FARE13_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE13_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE14, A.FARE14_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE14_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE15, A.FARE15_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE15_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE16, A.FARE16_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE16_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE17, A.FARE17_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE17_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE18, A.FARE18_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE18_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE19, A.FARE19_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE19_AGENCY_NAME, A.FARE20, A.FARE20_AGENCY_CODE, A.FARE20_AGENCY_NAME , A.SNAPSHOT_ID FROM AIR01.FLIGHT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT A WHERE A.SNAPSHOT_ID = #{snapshotId} AND A.RESERVATION_CODE = #{reservationCode} ) UNPIVOT ( (FARE, AGENCY_CODE, AGENCY_NAME) FOR RANK_NO IN ( (FARE1, FARE1_AGENCY_CODE, FARE1_AGENCY_NAME) AS 1, (FARE2, FARE2_AGENCY_CODE, FARE2_AGENCY_NAME) AS 2, (FARE3, FARE3_AGENCY_CODE, FARE3_AGENCY_NAME) AS 3, (FARE4, FARE4_AGENCY_CODE, FARE4_AGENCY_NAME) AS 4, (FARE5, FARE5_AGENCY_CODE, FARE5_AGENCY_NAME) AS 5, (FARE6, FARE6_AGENCY_CODE, FARE6_AGENCY_NAME) AS 6, (FARE7, FARE7_AGENCY_CODE, FARE7_AGENCY_NAME) AS 7, (FARE8, FARE8_AGENCY_CODE, FARE8_AGENCY_NAME) AS 8, (FARE9, FARE9_AGENCY_CODE, FARE9_AGENCY_NAME) AS 9, (FARE10, FARE10_AGENCY_CODE, FARE10_AGENCY_NAME) AS 10, (FARE11, FARE11_AGENCY_CODE, FARE11_AGENCY_NAME) AS 11, (FARE12, FARE12_AGENCY_CODE, FARE12_AGENCY_NAME) AS 12, (FARE13, FARE13_AGENCY_CODE, FARE13_AGENCY_NAME) AS 13, (FARE14, FARE14_AGENCY_CODE, FARE14_AGENCY_NAME) AS 14, (FARE15, FARE15_AGENCY_CODE, FARE15_AGENCY_NAME) AS 15, (FARE16, FARE16_AGENCY_CODE, FARE16_AGENCY_NAME) AS 16, (FARE17, FARE17_AGENCY_CODE, FARE17_AGENCY_NAME) AS 17, (FARE18, FARE18_AGENCY_CODE, FARE18_AGENCY_NAME) AS 18, (FARE19, FARE19_AGENCY_CODE, FARE19_AGENCY_NAME) AS 19, (FARE20, FARE20_AGENCY_CODE, FARE20_AGENCY_NAME) AS 20 ) ) T WHERE T.FARE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T.FARE ASC, T.RANK_NO ASC
